connector.name: Tianxia Gongchang - China Factory Search
connector.registryDescription: Search 4.8M verified Chinese factories: profiles, contacts, AI deep-dives, agentic sourcing.
connector.summary: Hosted at open.tianxiagongchang.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.tianxiagongchang, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <API key>. Create a free key at https://www.tianxiagongchang.com/open/console
